mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_auth_token (token_hash, tenant_id, user_id, username, permissions, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{tokenHash}, #{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{username}, #{permissions}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM iam_auth_token WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId}
